test_case.test_name: AMD in-band XGMI link1 correctable Table3.15 validation
test_case.purpose: Prove one approved correctable XGMI PCS event is reported for link1 and every fabric endpoint returns to the approved healthy state.
required_package: Approved amdgpuras version/hash/license and matching driver
AMD GPU RAS Tool guide Table3.15 or signed equivalent
All GPU UUID/OAM/BDF and XGMI endpoint topology
Expected link-specific driver fields and quiet-window oracle
test_case.test_command: Qualified operator records all-link and log baseline, safely establishes approved ras_enable=1, preserves the source device0/block0 UMC precheck as ancillary evidence, runs `amdgpuras -b 7 -l`, validates both link1 endpoints, executes `sudo amdgpuras -b 7 -s 1 -m 6 -t 2` once, captures complete driver/RAS evidence, then verifies every peer and link through the approved quiet window.
test_case.expected_result: The one-shot command succeeds; Table3.15-defined link1 correctable evidence is attributable to the selected endpoints; no fatal escalation, recurring BER, peer loss or link degradation remains.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires approved Table3.15 semantics, two-ended link mapping, one injection, exact link-specific log oracle and all-peer recovery. Generic dmesg, a zero UMC precheck alone, wrong peer, storm or degradation cannot pass.
safety_gate: Dedicated idle multi-GPU SUT and explicit XGMI injection approval.
Confirm both link1 endpoints and mode6/type2 semantics.
Do not clear logs; preserve full before/after evidence.
One injection only; no automatic retry/reset.
expected_evidence: UMC ancillary precheck and full XGMI baseline
Link enumeration, single command and complete driver/RAS logs
test_case.recovery: On wrong endpoint, fatal escalation, BER storm, peer loss or link degradation, stop and preserve evidence; use only the approved fabric/GPU/host/OOB recovery, restore ras_enable state and verify all peers before any new authorization.
